edges.reason: transfer uses _msgSender() as the debited account.
transferFrom reads msg.sender allowance and uses it as spender.
allowance subtraction writes back to _allowances mapping.
_transfer reads lpPairs to detect pair-side transfers.
_transfer triggers swapAndLiquify (external calls) before finalizing balances.
swapAndLiquify swaps tokens for ETH through the router.
swapAndLiquify adds liquidity through the router.
ETH is pushed to the marketing wallet after external swaps.
All residual ETH is pushed to the team wallet.
swapTokensForEth performs an external router swap call.
addLiquidity performs an external router value call.
block.timestamp is passed as the router swap deadline.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidity deadline.
takeTaxes multiplies amount by the selected fee.
fee amount is credited to the contract balance in _tOwned.
takeTaxes reads buyLog timestamps for the cooldown.
takeTaxes writes the buyer timestamp into buyLog.
buy cooldown check compares block.timestamp against buyLog.
isProtected (owner only) sets the _liqAddStatus tax gate.
setLpPair enforces a one-week cooldown using block.timestamp.
setLpPair writes the lpPairs whitelist mapping.
transferOwner calls setExcludedFromFees for old and new owner.
transferOwner moves the owner balance through _transfer.
setExcludedFromFees writes the fee exemption mapping.
constructor exempts owner, contract and DEAD from fees.
constructor marks the owner as a liquidity holder.
contractTokenBalance local is bounded and passed into swapAndLiquify.
toLiquify local splits the balance inside swapAndLiquify.
toSwapForEth local is derived inside swapAndLiquify.
toSwapForEth local is passed to swapTokensForEth.
currentBalance local reads address balance in swapAndLiquify.
liquidityBalance local is used for liquidity and marketing payouts.
currentFee local selects the applicable tax in takeTaxes.
feeAmount local is produced by the unsafe fee multiplication.
check local validates the new max transaction amount.
check local validates the new max wallet size.
_newRouter local wraps the new router address.
get_pair local stores the factory lookup result.
path local builds the swap route for swapTokensForEth.
timeInSeconds local converts the cooldown input.
